lines.text: Levi's sons were Gershon, Kohath and Merari, and Kohath's son Amram had children named Aaron, Moses and Miriam.
An Azariah served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem, and Jehozadak went into captivity under Nebuchadnezzar.
David put men in charge of the music, and they ministered with song before the palace until Solomon built the house of the LORD.
Aaron and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place to make atonement for Israel, as Joshua had commanded.
Aaron's descendants were given Hebron in Judah, but the fields and villages around the city went to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
